lines.en: I drift slowly through the darkness.
My arms trail across the seafloor sand.

lines.zh: 深处的水压着我的身体。
lines.en: The deep water presses on my body.
I do not like shallow places.
Eight arms draw in and push out together.
I glide down along the trench.
The shadow of a wreck lies below.
The deeper the water, the freer I feel.
I turn sideways, skirting a stone pillar.
Light never reaches my depth.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛比你的头还大。
lines.en: My eye is larger than your head.
A school of fish passes ahead.
I drag a long shadow behind me.
This layer of water is cold as iron.

lines.zh: 我把腕伸出去，摸到了石壁。
lines.en: I reach out a tentacle and find the rock wall.

lines.zh: 我往下沉，海水越来越黑。
lines.en: I sink and the water turns blacker.

lines.zh: 触腕拨开海草，我往前滑。
lines.en: My tentacle parts the kelp and I slide on.
One jet from my funnel and I shoot ahead.

lines.zh: 触腕一张，前面的路就清了。
lines.en: My arms spread, and the way ahead clears.
My tentacles are longer than a boat.

lines.zh: 再往下几十丈，水才够凉。
lines.en: A few dozen fathoms lower, the water is cool enough.
A string of bubbles rises behind me.
I keep my arms in and skirt the coral branches.

lines.zh: 暗流推着我，像有手在拽。
lines.en: The undercurrent shoves me like a hand pulling.
Today the water runs smoother than yesterday.
Riding the warm current saves me effort.
The deep's pressure feels good on me.
The salt grows stronger; the current is shifting.
That broken mast was not here yesterday.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛，是动物里最大的。
lines.en: Mine are the largest eyes in the animal kingdom.

lines.zh: 深海里，我的触手比船桅长。
lines.en: In the deep, my arms are longer than a mast.
The light above shatters and closes again.
I hang in the water, perfectly still.

lines.zh: 眼睛在找一点微弱的光。
lines.en: My eyes search for the faintest light.

lines.zh: 十格以上的水，才够我呼吸。
lines.en: I need more than ten blocks of water.
One arm curls on its own.
I blink once, very slowly.

lines.zh: 深处没有声音，只有压力。
lines.en: Down here, no sound, only pressure.
A small fish hovers nearby.

lines.zh: 我在等更大的东西经过。
lines.en: I wait for something larger to pass.
My skin is turning pale.
The current nudges me aside.

lines.zh: 我记得上一次下潜的深度。
lines.en: I recall the depth of my last descent.
Ink gathers slowly inside me.
I count my own slow heartbeats.
This trench is frighteningly quiet.
Deep-sea night never breaks.
The school will come; I wait.
Something stirs behind the reef.
Hanging in the water costs less than swimming.
The sound of the hull fades away.
This darkness is the darkness of water.

lines.zh: 海底的石柱，一根根立着。
lines.en: Pillars of stone stand one by one on the seabed.
The moss on deep-sea stone is soft.
One fish, two... I lost count again.
I'm hungry, but the fish hide from me.
My tentacles are longer than a mast.

lines.zh: 深海里连光都沉不下来。
lines.en: Even light can't sink this deep.
Time to rise somewhere shallower.
Eight arms sway slowly, like breathing.
Your light is harsh underwater.
You are not deep enough yet.

lines.zh: 我看你，用的是最大的眼。
lines.en: I watch you with the largest eyes.

lines.zh: 你身上绑着奇怪的管子。
lines.en: You wear strange tubes on your body.
Your breath lasts so briefly.
I come closer only to see you.
Your boots stir up the silt.
I hear you holding your breath up there.
Have you come for my tentacles?
I pass slowly over your head.
That hide of yours doesn't look from the sea.
Giant Squid? I'll remember that.
That glimmer stings my eye.
You have a scent but no scales.

lines.zh: 深海这么深，我的触手够长。
lines.en: The deep is deep, and my tentacles are long.
All I have is eyes. Big ones.

lines.zh: 深海太黑，我看不清你的脸。
lines.en: The deep is dark, I cannot see your face.

lines.zh: 深海的压力，我早就习惯了。
lines.en: I'm used to the deep-sea pressure.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上有铁腥味。
lines.en: I smell iron on you.

lines.zh: 我的触手比你整个人还长。
lines.en: My tentacles are longer than you are tall.
One of my arms is sliced open.
The ink is rising in me.
You dare touch something this deep.
I tighten my body and shield my head.
All eight arms are in disarray.
I will remember this depth.
Blood mixes with water and spreads.
I retreat into darker water.
Your blade is sharper than I thought.
I will return the favor.

lines.zh: 深海才是我待的地方，别追了。
lines.en: The deep sea is my place; stop chasing.
My mantle is split. No second blow.
You hurt my fin, and it stings.

lines.zh: 我的外套膜被划了一道。
lines.en: A slash across my mantle.
The pain makes me squirt a cloud of ink.
My tentacles just unfurled. Easy.

lines.zh: 深海的压力，替我挡了一下。
lines.en: The deep-sea pressure took part of that blow.
Why does the water smell of iron?

lines.zh: 深海里，我喷一口墨就够了。
lines.en: In the deep, one ink cloud is enough.

lines.zh: 腕足被砍断一截，还在抽。
lines.en: An arm is cut short and still twitching.
The smell of fish cuts through the water.
Luring me with fish is funny.
I want only that one fish.
Toss that fish a little farther.
Guardian flesh is what I truly want.

lines.zh: 我伸出触手，不是为了握手。
lines.en: I reach out, and not to shake hands.

lines.zh: 你的手在水里，像一条鱼。
lines.en: Your hand in the water looks like a fish.
When the fish sinks, I follow.
One bite keeps me for days.
You are at the surface, out of reach.

lines.zh: 那真的是小鱼，还是你的手？
lines.en: Is that really a small fish, or your hand?
That trace of blood drifts down the current.
In the deep, I want to grab everything.

lines.zh: 追着味，我从海沟爬上来了。
lines.en: Following the scent, I climbed up from the trench.
Scraps everywhere in the water — who did this?
I know this smell is a trap.
My tentacles are longer than your legs.
Little fish swim past my armor gaps.

lines.zh: 抹香鲸来了，我的触手危险了。
lines.en: The sperm whale comes. My tentacles are at risk.
That shiny thing — is it food?
You bumped into one of my arms.
I am this big; did you not see me?
Sorry, I have too many arms.
My hide pushed you aside.
Do not swim against my arms.
That bump barely registered.
Your air tank grazed me.
I turn, and the water sweeps you.
In the deep, everyone gives way.

lines.zh: 我收了一下触手，算道歉。
lines.en: I pull my arms in, as an apology.

lines.zh: 我的触手比你的船锚长。
lines.en: My arms are longer than your anchor.

lines.zh: 深海的水压比你的拳头重。
lines.en: Deep-sea pressure hits harder than your fist.
This whole sea, and you bump into me.

lines.zh: 深海里连光都到不了我。
lines.en: Not even light reaches me down here.
Even a soft body gets cross when shoved.
My arms tangled and I nearly capsized.
One bump, and the whole sea is churned.
The deep is wide. Do not crowd me.

lines.zh: 你走你的，我走我的水道。
lines.en: You take your way; I take my channel.
My fin went numb where you hit it.
In this vast sea, kin are rare.
I send a low pulse through the water.

lines.zh: 我们交叠触手，就算成对。
lines.en: Our arms intertwine; that makes a pair.

lines.zh: 现在不是时候，海压太浅。
lines.en: Not now; the pressure is too shallow.
The eggs will sink very deep.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣在另一条海沟。
lines.en: My mate waits in another trench.
Sound travels far underwater.
We circle each other slowly.
Hatchlings can swim from birth.
Do not come near me while I breed.
Come to the trench edge with me; it's quiet.
In the deep, I know only you.
Arms beside arms, let's swim down together.

lines.zh: 深海这么大，只找你一个。
lines.en: The deep is vast; I look for only you.
My arms curl around you, gently.

lines.zh: 我的腕足碰了碰你的腕足。
lines.en: My arm brushed against yours.
From one sea to the next I searched.
I cleared a nest in a reef crevice.

lines.zh: 深海里的鳞片，我很少见。
lines.en: Scales are rare this deep.
The current will keep watch for us.

lines.zh: 我卷起一块沉船的木板。
lines.en: I curl around a plank from the wreck.
That ink sac is one I dropped.
I nudge it closer with an arm.
I often pick up bones on the seabed.
I curled three times, and it still slipped.
I lift it, then put it back in the sand.
This thing does not look like fish.
I wrap it in an arm and carry it.
Everything that sinks belongs to me.
I am keeping the sword you dropped.

lines.zh: 沉下来的东西，我都收着。
lines.en: Whatever sinks, I keep.
How did this come to lie on the seabed?

lines.zh: 触手尖上，捡来的东西晃。
lines.en: Something I picked up dangles from my tentacle tip.
The shell is hard; so is my beak.
I keep every sunken thing down here.
I touched this sunken pile first.

lines.zh: 深海这么深，谁掉的东西？
lines.en: This deep, whose thing could this be?
Slick, yes, but no scales.
It sank slowly down from the surface.
Under the sand, no one will find it.

lines.zh: 那条守卫者游进了我的海。
lines.en: A guardian swam into my waters.
The school is moving; I have chosen.
My target is small but filling.
One fish is enough; I am not greedy.
I spread my arms to close them.
Something glows in the deep water.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛锁住了那点光。
lines.en: My eyes lock onto that little light.
Guardians will come; I will wait.
This target is hard-shelled.
I entangle first, then eat slowly.
It's alone — my tentacles reach out.
The deep is dark, it never saw me.
This fish delivered itself to me.
My arms reach once. Take it.

lines.zh: 暗流把我的心跳藏住了。
lines.en: The current hides my heartbeat.
No one takes it from my arms.

lines.zh: 深海里，我的触手先咬住。
lines.en: In the deep, my tentacles bite first.
Two coils of tentacle, tightening.
Don't flick your tail; I've circled you.
My arms have been itching for this.
You do not swim fast at this depth.
My arms are longer than your legs.
The current pushes you toward me.
I follow your trail of bubbles.
Look back: all eight arms are there.
There is nowhere to hide down here.
I circle slowly; you have not noticed.
Your lantern reveals your position.

lines.zh: 三根触手已经伸过去了。
lines.en: Three arms are already reaching out.
Do not swim upward; it will not help.

lines.zh: 你搅起的泥沙，全告诉我。
lines.en: The mud you stir tells me everything.

lines.zh: 浅水会卡住我这副大身子。
lines.en: The shallows will jam this huge body of mine.

lines.zh: 触手已经绕到你身后了。
lines.en: A tentacle already curled behind you.

lines.zh: 深海里我先听见你的心跳。
lines.en: In the deep I hear your heartbeat first.
Turn as you like; my arms reach far.

lines.zh: 我这十条腕，比你的船还长。
lines.en: My ten arms outrun your boat.
In the deep, you can't outswim me.
My arms contract and the water churns.
I won't stop even at the trench floor.
Your paddling sounds closer and closer.
One arm has wrapped around you.
I have hooked your arm.

lines.zh: 这一下不算重，只是提醒。
lines.en: This one is light, only a reminder.
The suckers have stuck to you.
I lash out with my third arm.
The slime will make you slip.
I wrap, I pull, I let go.

lines.zh: 你的护甲在吸盘下没用。
lines.en: Your armor is useless against suckers.
This blow came from behind you.
I used only a fraction of my strength.

lines.zh: 触手先缠住，鳍再推一把。
lines.en: The arms wrap first, then the fins shove.
My arms snap shut; nowhere to dodge.
Up you go — plenty of air there.

lines.zh: 我的触手比你的船还长。
lines.en: My tentacles are longer than your boat.

lines.zh: 触手上的钩，一排排张开。
lines.en: Rows of hooks open along my tentacles.
One lash of my arm muddies the water.

lines.zh: 这一下，替被网住的同伴。
lines.en: This one's for the kin caught in nets.
The suckers still hold you. Wait.
Only two of my eight arms have moved.
Gurgle, catch this cloud of ink.

lines.zh: 我在没有光的水层醒来。
lines.en: I wake in a layer without light.
Only pressure and blackness surround me.
My first breath came through gills.
Far, far above, there is light.
The sand on the seabed is soft.

lines.zh: 我已经是这么大的身体。
lines.en: I am already this large.
There are splinters of a wreck here.
I try curling all my arms at once.
This trench is my home.
I will grow larger here.

lines.zh: 我从黑水里慢慢浮上来。
lines.en: I rise slowly out of the black water.
Something sounds deep in the trench.

lines.zh: 八条腕一起张开，比船还长。
lines.en: Eight arms spread wider than a boat.

lines.zh: 这么大的触手，先伸个懒腰。
lines.en: Such long tentacles need a good stretch first.
Just awake; my arms won't straighten yet.
First I'll circle this reef once.
Cold water over my gills feels good.
Deep water — cool and comfortable.
The quieter the deep, the better.
My tentacles are longer than a boat.
Fire underwater burns strangely.
Even the deep sea got burned.
I slam hard onto the seafloor.
I hit the reef and my arms go numb.
Out of the water, I go limp.
Out of water, my arms go limp.
The shock leaves my insides numb.

lines.zh: 水里炸开，我的触手全乱了。
lines.en: An underwater blast scrambles all my arms.
A harpoon is stuck in my arm.

lines.zh: 箭扎进外套膜，拔不出来。
lines.en: An arrow is stuck in my mantle.
Blue light makes my arms cramp.
Purple light crawls into my arms and numbs them.
The water is empty; I have not fed.

lines.zh: 深海没有海草，只有冷和黑。
lines.en: Down here there's no kelp, only cold and dark.
Lightning is bright even underwater.

lines.zh: 这么深的海，雷也找得到我。
lines.en: Even this deep, the lightning finds me.
The seabed fell away into nothing.

lines.zh: 下面比海沟还深，没有回声。
lines.en: Deeper than any trench, and no echo comes back.
